note: The stars under FNaF 1's title logo, left to right. A slot is a star when at least half of the 16x16 box at its centre is near-white (every channel >= 230): the solid core of a filled star. Measured on all 97 retained FNaF 1 title frames on this host: every one of the 291 slot reads is exactly 0.0 or 1.0, and every frame fills its slots left to right (0, 2 or 3 stars). The static behind the title never fills a core box. A star count is read only on a frame the title model itself reads as the title (title-observe.py, confident); this model reads no menu item and no other screen.
